description.default: Show the signed-in employee's annual total rewards across salary, bonus, equity, pension, and employer-funded benefits. Use for prompts such as 'What is my total compensation?', 'Show my annual rewards', or 'What is my employment package worth?'. Do not use for one pay statement; use GetLatestPay, or to explain a pay difference; use ExplainPayChange. Pass year, currency, includeEquity, or includeBenefitsValue only when stated.
